title: The Divine Invasion
theological_headline: The Divine Invasion's Bible-into-hologram is PKD's fiction of God re-entering an occluded world through time seen as space.
intro:
*The Divine Invasion*, PKD's late sequel to *VALIS*, appears once in the Exegesis, cited as a fictional embodiment of his mature cosmology: God's re-entry into an occluded world, and time turned literally into space. The novel's device of the Bible expanded into a walk-through hologram becomes, for PKD, a picture of the very perceptual leap he claims 2-3-74 granted him. (Lane B: PKD reading his own late fiction.)

With a single mention, this page keeps its scope to that one use; Emmanuel and Zina are not developed in the passage, and the page does not supply them.
theological_synthesis:
The theological use is to illustrate PKD's late metaphysics of the living information life-form. In [89:11] he describes an entity that "doesn't have Logos; it is Logos" — a being whose body is its own information — and argues that the next step in human evolution is to see it, seeing time as space through a third, ajna eye. He then points to his own fiction as having already staged this: "it extends along the temporal axis as a spatial axis; hence my Bible-into-hologram in *Divine Invasion*."

The novel's holographic scripture, and its seeing of "King Felix," are read as depictions of the four-dimensional structure PKD calls the MMSK, in which the past does not perish but is permanently preserved. The divine invasion of the title thus becomes, in his self-reading, the irruption of this living Logos into a three-dimensional world that is really the four-dimensional structure "imperfectly seen" — God re-entering not from outside but from a dimension we cannot yet perceive.

mentions.summary: January 3, 1981 The incident of the pink light and the info about Chrissy differed from normal daily reality only in this regard: I was consciously aware of it; we must subliminally pick it up, like my engramming on the fish (teeth) necklace. Evolution-wise we must be like the apes in _2001;_ we are on the lip-edge of evolving to where we'll see Valis/the plasmate. It's like _Close Encounters_ at the end. A life form, sacred and beautiful, right here. An information life form. It is what it says; it doesn't have Logos; it is Logos. Its body is its own information. There. This is why it takes the form of physical arrangements into info. This life form is that. Damn it, it's a life form that doesn't use info; it is info.[*] Time turns literally to space: both another (fourth) spatial dimension but we see this imperfectly as augmented 3-D (space). This is why the past doesn't perish in the MMSK, why when something goes into it—is incorporated into it—it is permanent. The past is still there—this is the essence of the MMSK, to preserve the past (as what I call reticulated phylogons). The MMSK exists in 4 spatial dimensions and is physically right here; our 3-D world is it, imperfectly seen. Hence we can't discriminate (live info) set to ground. The next step in human evolution will gain this as-it-were ultraparallaxis. As we previously added color. [...] My God the truth (true explanation) is quite simple: I saw in 4-D and saw a living info life form here. Why, it extends along the temporal axis as a spatial axis; hence my Bible-into-hologram in _Divine Invasion._ And seeing King Felix. The various physical-depth levels in _Tears._ Time as space. mentions.gloss: PKD cites *The Divine Invasion*'s Bible-into-hologram as his own fiction of the four-dimensional structure he calls the MMSK, where time extends as a spatial axis and the past is permanently preserved. The living information life-form that "is Logos" re-enters our three-dimensional world — really that structure "imperfectly seen" — a divine invasion perceived only by the coming evolutionary leap that sees time as space. Emmanuel and Zina are not treated here; the novel is invoked for its holographic scripture and the seeing of King Felix.
